modes.description: `defaultPageSize` pages the view of the whole `data`.

modes.label: Server pagination
modes.description: The server returns one page per request.

modes.label: Scroll mode
modes.description: `useDataGridServerRows` in scroll mode fetches row blocks on scroll.

modes.label: Own API

API.reason: Set values are read-only input of the filter; writes through onDataChange or onSave never read them.

features.note: The grid's search highlights and navigates loaded rows and never narrows them. `useDataGridServerRows` sends the text as `spec.searchText`, so your server can narrow the result.

FS.reason: Search highlights loaded rows and never filters.

L.reason: A local array holds every row, so `useDataGridAggregate` totals it without a fetch.

PC.reason: A client grid with `defaultPageSize` holds every row, so `useDataGridAggregate` totals it without a fetch.

features.feature: Row create, duplicate, delete, and move

L.reason: The client sorts and filters the pushed rows itself. With the default `reorder: "defer"`, a pushed row keeps its position and `viewStale` turns on. `reconcileView()` or the next sort, filter, or search change moves the row. `reorder: "immediate"` moves it at once. See [Stream updates](/docs/rows-live-data/stream-updates).

PC.reason: The client sorts and filters the pushed rows itself. With the default `reorder: "defer"`, a pushed row keeps its position and `viewStale` turns on. `reconcileView()` or the next sort, filter, or search change moves the row. `reorder: "immediate"` moves it at once. See [Stream updates](/docs/rows-live-data/stream-updates).

C.reason: URL state drives the controlled props itself.

FS.note: A deep-linked set-filter list keeps at most as many values as the static `choices` of the column, and at least 64. The grid drops the values past that bound, and an `isNoneOf` list past it drops the whole filter.

Z.reason: `overscan` already loads rows ahead on both sides.
Scroll mode and pagination are exclusive.

PC.reason: The length of `data` is the total.

features.note: Pages mode pages without a total through `hasMore`, or through a `nextCursor` chain: each page request carries the `cursor` of the page before. Scroll mode loads a source without a count in order.

L.reason: A local array needs no fetch.
